title: Degrees of Uncertainty: Conformal Deep Learning for Core Body Temperature Prediction in Extreme Environments
summary: A bidirectional LSTM maps wearable time series to core-temperature estimates, with conformal prediction calibrating their uncertainty. The preprint compares these estimates and intervals with ECTemp in its monitoring evaluation. Improved health outcomes and prospective operational benefit are not reported.
